The Moon trades Scorpio for Sagittarius today.

The Moon moves from Scorpio into Sagittarius mid-morning and meets Mercury this afternoon. Early this morning Mercury sent Neptune a friendly trine. Swipe for Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Water friend. 🌙
